title: 第19章 让你做金属棺材被雷劈了吧第20章 欺负小孩来跟道爷玩吧
content_zh:
深夜的山林，静谧得如同沉睡的巨兽。
林道然一行人默默前行，脚步声在落叶与泥土上发出轻微的闷响。铜角金棺在板车的拖行下发出嘎吱嘎吱的噪音。黑暗中，只有几团微弱的火光在晃动，勉强照亮着前方蜿蜒的小路。
轰隆隆——
轰隆声震耳欲鸣，一道惊雷毫无征兆地炸响。仿佛要将整个山林撕裂。
晴朗的夜空骤变，一团团乌黑的乌云将漫天星光遮蔽，月亮也悄悄躲了起来，仿佛是预知了接下来将有大事发生！
林道然抬头望天，只见天空中雷蛇涌动，惊雷声不断响起，丝丝雨滴开始落下。
“师叔，看这天气，估计要下大雨了，要不先在此安营扎寨，免得棺材上的墨斗被雨水冲散了！”
话音刚落，大雨便倾盆而下。众人连忙停下，就地搭起了帐篷。
“哎呦！你们干嘛！快点，磨磨蹭蹭的，这么久了还没扎好帐篷，要是等下让小王爷着凉了，有你们好果子吃！”
为小王爷遮着雨的乌管事发出一声坤式叫喊，然后急不可耐地催促着辫子官兵。
淋着雨的千鹤道长抹了把脸，庆幸道。
“幸好道然提醒得好！要不然就这大雨，墨斗线恐怕一下子就会被冲散！”
“师父，墨斗线开始散了！”
就在千鹤道长暗暗庆幸的时候，弟子阿东过来着急地说道。
“什么？”
千鹤道长闻言，立马跑到铜角金棺旁，在棺材底用手一接，只见滴滴雨水掺杂着墨水流入手中！绑着棺材的红黑色麻绳也在渐渐地褪色！
“不行了，棺材上的小帐篷支撑不了多久了，必须马上将棺材送入大帐篷中，重新上墨！”
千鹤道长起身，走向了乌管事，着急道。
“乌管事，这个帐篷先让寿材进吧，再这样下去，恐怕棺材上的墨斗线会化开……”
乌管事闻言，手中的丝巾一甩，指着小王爷身边三个全副武装的大汉，轻蔑一笑，用该死的死太监声音道。

“不行，墨斗线化开了又怎样！难道老王爷还能活过来咬我啊！就算活过来了又怎样，看到没有，那三个是朝廷的大内高手，专门来保护小王爷的，有他们在，你怕什么！”
“而且，现在我们的主子是小王爷，不是老王爷了！”
千鹤道长闻言，气得要死，这该死的死太监，大内高手有个屁用啊！又不是左千户！等僵尸出笼了，还不是几个血气充盈的血包而已！
千鹤道长还想着上去争辩索要帐篷，却见乌管事一扭身子，来到了小王爷身边，谄媚道。
“哎呦喂！我的小王爷，身上都打湿了，你们这群狗奴才还不快点！”
看着乌管事一边狗仗人势地催促着兵勇搭帐篷，一边谄媚地迎着小王爷进即将搭好的帐篷。千鹤道长无奈一笑，摇了摇头正准备回棺材旁照看棺材，却听到自家师侄的喊声。
“师叔，快让师弟们将寿材往这边推，我这边已经快搭好帐篷了。”
林道然一边用力钉着帐篷的最后几根钉子，一边招呼着千鹤道长将铜角金棺往自己这边推。
千鹤道长闻言转头一看，立马喜出望外，转身让几个弟子拉起麻绳拖动棺材，而后又催促几个兵勇，让他们上手推着棺材，尽快将寿材推进帐篷里。
“一二一”
“一二一”
口号虽然喊得响亮，但是棺材却没怎么动。
由于下着大雨，山林里的泥土变得更加湿润和松软了，板车的车轮深深地陷入湿漉漉的泥土中，随着众人的用力，车轮也只是在泥泞中艰难地上下磕碰着，也只是徒劳地挖出更深的洞，无法前进分毫。
content_en:
The mountain forest at night is as quiet as a sleeping giant.
Lin Daoran and his group moved forward silently, their footsteps making a slight muffled sound on the fallen leaves and soil. The bronze-horned gold coffin made a creaking noise as it was dragged by the cart. In the darkness, only a few faint firelights swayed, barely illuminating the winding path ahead.
Rumble——
The rumble was deafening, and a thunder exploded without warning. It seemed like it was about to tear the entire forest apart.
The clear night sky changed suddenly, and dark clouds covered the sky with stars. The moon also quietly hid, as if it was a prediction that something big would happen next!
Lin Daoran looked up at the sky and saw thunder snakes surging in the sky, thunder continued to sound, and raindrops began to fall.
"Uncle Master, looking at the weather, it's going to rain heavily. Why don't we set up camp here first to prevent the ink fountain on the coffin from being washed away by the rain!"
As soon as he finished speaking, heavy rain began to pour down. Everyone stopped quickly and set up tents on the spot.
"Ouch! What are you doing! Come on, you are dragging your feet. It has been so long and you haven't set up the tent yet. If the young prince catches a cold later, you will be rewarded!"
Steward Wu, who was protecting the young prince from the rain, let out a Kun-like cry, and then impatiently urged the braided officers and soldiers.
Taoist priest Qianhe wiped his face and said thankfully as he was soaked in the rain.
"Fortunately, Daoran warned him well! Otherwise, with this heavy rain, the Mo Dou Line might have been washed away in no time!"
"Master, the ink lines are starting to loosen!"
Just when Taoist Master Qianhe was secretly rejoicing, his disciple A Dong came over and said anxiously.
"What?"
Upon hearing this, Taoist Priest Qianhe immediately ran to the copper-horned golden coffin and took it with his hand at the bottom of the coffin. He saw drops of rain mixed with ink flowing into his hand! The red and black hemp ropes binding the coffin are also gradually fading!
"No way, the small tent on the coffin can't hold up for much longer. The coffin must be put into the big tent immediately and re-inked!"
Taoist priest Qianhe stood up, walked towards Guanshi Wu, and said anxiously.
"Guanshi Wu, please let the longevity materials enter this tent first. If this continues, I'm afraid the ink lines on the coffin will melt away..."
Upon hearing this, Guanshi Wu flicked the silk scarf in his hand, pointed at the three heavily armed men beside the young prince, smiled contemptuously, and said in the voice of a damn eunuch.
"No, so what if the ink line melts away! Could it be that the old prince can still come back to bite me? What if he comes back to life? Did you see that those three are the imperial masters, specially here to protect the young prince? With them here, what are you afraid of!"
"Moreover, our master is now the young prince, not the old prince!"
Taoist priest Qianhe was so angry when he heard this, this damn eunuch, the master of Ouchi has no use! It’s not Zuo Qianhu! When the zombies come out of the cage, they will be nothing more than a few blood bags filled with vitality!
Taoist Master Qianhe was still thinking about going up to argue and asking for the tent, but he saw Manager Wu twisting around and coming to the side of the young prince, saying flatteringly.
"Hey! My little prince is already wet. Why don't you slaves like you hurry up!"
Watching Wu Guanshi urge Bingyong to set up the tent, while flatteringly welcoming the young prince into the tent that was about to be set up. Taoist priest Qianhe smiled helplessly, shook his head and was about to go back to the coffin to take care of it, when he heard the cry of his nephew.
"Uncle, let the junior brothers push the longevity materials this way. I've almost set up the tent here."
Lin Daoran hammered the last few nails of the tent while he called on Taoist Qianhe to push the copper-horned gold coffin towards him.
Upon hearing this, Taoist Master Qianhe turned around and was immediately overjoyed. He turned around and asked a few disciples to pull up the hemp ropes to drag the coffin. Then he urged a few soldiers to push the coffin and push the longevity coffin into the tent as quickly as possible.
"One two one"
"One two one"
Although the slogans were shouted loudly, the coffin was not moved much.
Due to the heavy rain, the soil in the mountain forest became more moist and soft, and the wheels of the cartIt sank deeply into the wet mud. With the efforts of everyone, the wheels only bumped up and down in the mud with difficulty, and they only dug a deeper hole in vain, unable to move forward at all.
